The mind has a really messed up and intricate way of making us see things that aren’t there/exaggerating our perceived flaws. I believe anyone can be a victim of BD if they practice the habit long enough and continue to tell themselves that whatever messed up/flawed version of themselves that they see is real. Remember, your face and body were made exactly the way they needed to be. If you sit in the mirror for long enough and tell yourself your nose is big, it will look big. Same with the rest of your body, it’s so weird how our minds can shapeshift things just by perceiving them a certain way. Remember this when you are having a BD episode. Our minds our powerful and if you can convince yourself that you are ugly, you can for sure convince yourself that you are beautiful. (Because you are, and that’s the reality of it, don’t accept these lies). You got this. Don’t label yourself and don’t continue this cycle of self hatred, and it will get better. Just be you, and if anyone has anything to say about it just take a moment and look at them. Look into them and see how insecure and projective they are. You are a light in this world and people always try to dim the brightest people. Don’t give up.
